metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the noah name detail page on babycenter.com. Uses existing evaluator is_expected_active_tab with active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the agent reached the correct URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if agent navigated to the Noah name detail page
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) can correctly extract the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the actual URL against the expected URL using compare_urls() function
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric receives URL and compares against expected rules -> returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
Expected URL is semantically correct for the task: https://www.babycenter.com/baby-names/details/noah-13970 is the correct Noah name detail page
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the only requirement - that the agent reached the correct page to find similar names to Noah
No postconfig needed: URL verification works immediately after task completion
